newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay Chicago flights backs cargo plan.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Chicago flights backs cargo plan.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said the restart of the airline's cargo service to Chicago is part of its plans to develop the U.S. market.

"This is the second stage in Cathay Pacific's plans to penetrate the U.S. market. Chicago offers us an excellent foothold in the industrial heartland of the U.S," general manager cargo James Barrington said in a statement.
"It provides excellent connections for almost any destination in the eastern U.S. states," he added.
Cathay handed over its Chicago freighter service last September to cargo airline subsidiary AHK Air Hong Kong Ltd.

However AHK said its Boeing 747-200 freighter fleet was not efficient enough for a viable service and planned to increase capacity to European and Japanese destinations instead. AHK is 75 percent owned by Hong Kong's de facto flag carrier.

The new Cathay freighter service will be four times weekly leaving Hong Kong on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Saturdays using a Boeing 747-400 freighter. -Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 -www.racs.com
